source: Gaia DR3 gaia_source, ESA Gaia Archive TAP synchronous query
citation: Gaia Collaboration, Vallenari et al. 2023, A&A 674, A1
selection: Every Gaia DR3 source within 0.006 deg (21.6 arcsec) of HD 189733, brightest first. HD 189733 A is 1827242816201846144 and its M-dwarf companion HD 189733 B is 1827242816176111360.
units: ra and dec in deg; ra_error, dec_error, parallax and parallax_error in mas; ra_error is the error of ra cos dec; pmra and pmdec in mas/yr; ref_epoch in Julian years.
coverage: Five rows are two-parameter solutions with no proper motion or parallax. Source 1827242816176119296 has a 34 mas declination error with RA-Dec correlation 0.97, the most elongated ellipse in the table.
independentCheck: Astropy 8.0.1 SkyCoord.spherical_offsets_to from HD 189733 A gives the offsets asserted in tools/objects/telescopes/families/f09-astrometry.test.mts.
